text_block_list.text:
Finally,
Debut Selection day arrived.
Rhein Kraft rapidly built strength,
entering today in prime form.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Thanks to you, Trainer-san,
I'm totally ready!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Still, can't let guard down. Because――!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Refuse to yield! Alright,
showtime.
Time to show everyone how true queen runs!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Preparation complete. Now,
only delivering results remains……!
――Watch closely, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……I will not hand it over.
I shall prove my rightful claim to lead……Tiara
belongs to me――!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like me……they're aiming straight for
Tiara stage.
Everyone wants to shine out there.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is formidable. My true rivals.
……Which is why――!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them I'm number one!
Prove I'm future Triple Tiara winner!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let's do this!

And curtain rose on dramatic Debut Selection
Race――!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fierce contest for lead!
Rhein Kraft and Daring Heart secure prime
spots up front!

text_block_list.name: Kraft & Heart
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah, hah……!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa……i-isn't level insanely high?!
Never seen Debut Selection heat like
this……!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ……! Rhein Kraft-san――

Far surpassing normal pre-debut standards,
race captivated entire crowd.
Reporters couldn't look away.
Race charged toward final stretch……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Right here……! HAAAAAAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Won't let you! YAAAAAAAAAAA———!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
From behind,
Cesario and Air Messiah launch furious final
sprint! 400 meters remaining,
closing fast!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! No way I'm letting you through……!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Aah! I feel it! Heart-san, Messiah-san,
Cesario……everyone's feelings clashing
together……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Of course,
everyone here is strong!
Every runner chasing Tiara is incredible!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (That's exactly why――!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I'm the one who will stand at top!
I'll prove it right here――!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Final 200 meters! Rhein Kraft refuses to yield!
Cesario right behind!
Daring Heart and Air Messiah closing in!

text_block_list.name: Rivals
text_block_list.text: 『I will!』『I will!』『I will!』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will――!

text_block_list.name: All 4
text_block_list.text: 『I WILL WIIIIIIIIIIIN———!』
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible roar……! Man,
this generation is insane!
Seeing this before official debut……!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ……Yeah. Absolutely stunning――

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just as promised,
message delivered loud and clear,
Kraft-san.
Expectations for upcoming Tiara route……are
sky-high!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah…… Whew～～～……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san……! Ehehe, you came.

Words that escaped my mouth felt mundane,
making me feel slightly inadequate.
But she……performed miraculously.

Not just raising own performance,
but elevating rivals too――

She turned race into heart-stirring battle
where true strength shone brightest.
choice_data_list: You really……are an amazing Uma Mus...
You really……are an amazing Uma Mus...

text_block_list.text:
……Talent and drive so dazzling,
I questioned whether rookie trainer like me
was truly worthy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Please become my trainer!
Looking forward to working together!

Before I could voice doubt,
she blindsided me. I stood frozen.
Seeing me like that――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san……didn't you say you could see
my dream already? You told me yourself,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Said you love Tiara route. Said together,
we could prove our strength.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Once I set mind on something, I'm stubborn,
you know! ――That's why!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want you as my trainer.
I won't give up on this either.
Definitely not giving up!

Her earnest gaze completely disarmed me.
Hearing resolve like that, mind was made.
choice_data_list: From now on, I'm looking forward t...
From now on, I'm looking forward t...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's conquer Triple Tiara together!
